companies.name: Deloitte USI
companies.fact_remarks: Deloitte USI visited campus for 3 consecutive placement cycles (2024-2026) offering a fixed CTC of 7.5 LPA plus 1.0 LPA performance bonus for Analyst roles.
companies.observation_remarks: Historical placement records indicate high conversion for candidates demonstrating proficiency in SQL JOINs, CTEs, and interactive Power BI dashboards.

companies.name: Amazon
companies.fact_remarks: Amazon conducted on-campus & pool placement drives in 2025 and 2026 offering SDE-1 roles at 18.0 LPA and BIE roles at 16.0 LPA.
companies.observation_remarks: Bar raiser interviews strictly evaluate Amazon Leadership Principles alongside LeetCode Medium/Hard algorithmic efficiency.

companies.name: ZS Associates
companies.fact_remarks: ZS Associates offered 13.5 LPA CTC for Business Technology Consulting roles in 2025 with a 7.0 CGPA eligibility threshold.
companies.observation_remarks: Combines structured coding assessments with live market entry and revenue guesstimate discussions.

companies.name: Microsoft
companies.fact_remarks: Microsoft visited campus as a premier recruiter in 2025 offering 24.0 LPA base + stock grant compensation packages.
companies.observation_remarks: Strong preference shown for candidates with published research, competitive programming ratings, or production AI projects.

companies.name: Accenture
companies.fact_remarks: Accenture recruited 120+ students across engineering streams during 2024-2026 placement seasons.
companies.observation_remarks: Baseline CGPA cutoff of 6.0 allows wide participation; selection correlates strongly with verbal assessment and core coding scores.

companies.name: Goldman Sachs
companies.fact_remarks: Goldman Sachs offered 20.0 LPA for Quantitative Engineering and Data Infrastructure roles in 2025-2026.
companies.observation_remarks: Requires rigorous mathematical problem solving, probability calculations, and low-latency C++/Python optimization.
